name: EV Charging Dashboard
updateContentCommand: [ -f packages.txt ] && sudo apt-get update && sudo xargs apt-get install -y < packages.txt; [ -f requirements.txt ] && python -m pip install --user -r requirements.txt; echo 'Environment ready'

postAttachCommand.server: python -m streamlit run EV-Charging-Analytics.py --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false
